entities.name: Ernesto Rodríguez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ernesto Hernán Rodríguez Gómez is a volleyball player who represented Spain at the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney, Australia. There he finished ninth place with the Spanish men's national volleyball team. He also competed at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, Spain.
